U.S. CONTAINER IMPORTS HIT THIRD-HIGHEST LEVEL EVER

U.S. container imports reached 2.6 million TEUs in August, the third-highest monthly level on record, according to Descartes.

Volumes rose 3% year-over-year and 22% versus August 2019, signaling resilient consumer demand
